description: Repeat the producer/transport prefix from exploration with an input admission event before handlePrepare, then compare the decoded VBallot to that same operation input. This is the local preservation claim, not a cluster endpoint.

harness.description: Three bounded empty replicas; propose at owner 1, deliver its real PreAccept to acceptor 2, initiate recovery at replica 0, deliver its real Prepare to acceptor 2, decode the actual SendMsg reply.
semantic_changes: Replace constructor startup and TCP sockets with constructor-equivalent empty protocol containers and separate per-link byte buffers.
Call private handlers synchronously; no event loop, timer, execution worker or crash is modeled.
Reduce instance arrays to four entries; only instance 1.0 is touched. No produced instance field or message is edited.
Hold the PreAcceptReply and unused Prepare bytes without delivering them.

legality.derivation: Empty rows, counters -1, empty conflict maps, N=3 F=1, thriftiness and cyclic peer preference match initialization. handlePropose produces ballot 1 and actual bytes; handlePreAccept creates the stored value. startRecoveryForInstance produces Prepare ballot 3; handlePrepare consumes it. The probe omits worker/network startup and invokes recovery directly, so it establishes the admitted local producer input rather than end-to-end recovery reachability.
legality.applicability: Single synchronous test owns all replica objects and buffers. Before the producer call, the input event samples the actual instance value ballot and identity; after its synchronous SendMsg flush, a fresh object decodes the complete untouched byte stream.

grounding.derivation: Read decoded_vballot from the actual fresh decoded reply; compare to the earlier admitted.vballot. Correlation fields are the actual acceptor ID, replica and instance, never the ballot.
grounding.applicability: The result occurs only after successful full decoding of the corresponding synchronous producer output. Go assertions check framing, independent identity and other payload fields without filtering the value-ballot comparison.

observable_properties.description: The decoded accepted-value ballot equals the value sampled for the same admitted producer operation.

uncertainties: No decision or application endpoint is observed; loss of this field is not alone proof of a consensus safety violation.
The constructor/event-loop/timer bypass is explicit; local codec applicability is grounded independently in the producer/receiver contract.
